name: chatcom
description: Reusable local communication relay between Work and Codex.

scripts.test: npm run clean && npm run build && node --test dist/test/app-server-client.test.js dist/test/message-contract.test.js dist/test/local-relay.test.js dist/test/differential-diagnostic.test.js dist/test/codex-sdk-relay.test.js dist/test/portable-relay.test.js scripts/differential-diagnostic.test.mjs
scripts.validate-config: npm run build && node dist/portable-cli.js validate --config relay.config.example.json
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run validate-config && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
